standard_prerequisites: the localization functor epsilon from the small etale site to the Zariski site and the description of epsilon^*F as epsilon^{-1}F tensor O_etale
generation by finitely many sections on an etale covering
construction of the inverse image functor and descent of sections after shrinking
faithful flatness of etale morphisms of schemes on stalks
core_obligations: Prove that an O_X-module F is of finite type iff its pullback epsilon^*F is of finite type on the small etale site
proof_roadmap: The forward direction is the general local pullback fact for modules on sites

For the converse, start with an etale covering on which epsilon^*F is finitely generated; expanding the generating sections through the tensor description of epsilon^*F, after refining the covering etale-locally the sections come from actual sections t_{ij} of F over an open U
The induced map O_U^N to F|_U pulls back to a surjection on the etale cover X'' over U; since etale morphisms are faithfully flat on stalks, surjectivity descends, so t_{ij} generate F|_U
difficulty_reason: H2: a section-descent argument through the tensor description of the pullback, closing with faithful flatness on stalks.
